partnershipPlan: Two lay committee members read the draft summary; an emergency physician and a telephone triage nurse review the evidence classes.
socialListening: Public app-store reviews of the two apps are read for reports of wrong advice, labelled as unverified anecdotes.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: It told me to rest at home and I felt better knowing that, but I would still have gone in if it got worse.
items.implication: Report what users do with advice, not only the advice.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: Every over-cautious app sends us people who needed a pharmacist.
Composite paraphrase: The app did not seem to know how serious a fever is in a newborn.
Composite paraphrase: The questions used words my grandmother does not use.
items.implication: Ask companies for results in users with limited English.

summary: Four composite voices on reassurance, crowding, infants and language.
